newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Pirelli Tyre provisional 96 net NLG 95 mln. [CORRECTED 08:57 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Pirelli Tyre provisional 96 net NLG 95 mln. [CORRECTED 08:57 GMT]

text.p: Pirelli-Tyre Holding NV said provisional figures showed it made a net profit of some 95 million guilders in 1996, a rise of some 42 million guilders compared with 1995.
Amsterdam-listed Pirelli-Tyre is 93.6 (corrects from 81) percent owned by Italy's Pirelli SpA.
Pirelli Tyre said these provisional net profit figures were stated after the deduction of profits due to minority interests.
Group net profit before such deductions came to around 150 million guilders, a rise of over 75 percent compared to 1995.
Net sales for 1996 amounted to 5.65 billion guilders, which represented a rise of riughly one percent after elimination of exchange rate movements, Pirelli Tyre said.
The company said it expected to make "reasonable" profit in 1997 even though demand was expected to remain stagnant.
Pirelli has launched a public offer of 19.50 guilders per share for the shares in Pirelli tyre which it does not already own.
